# Opiuml

> Opiuml is a podcast player for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and CarPlay, built around two lists: an Inbox for every new episode and a Queue for what you actually want to hear.

Coming soon to the App Store.

Key facts:

- Platform: iPhone and iPad (iOS/iPadOS 18 or later), Apple Watch (watchOS 11 or later) and CarPlay
- Price: £29.99 a year, with a one-week free trial for new subscribers
- Privacy: no accounts, analytics or tracking; the library lives on the device and syncs through the user's own iCloud
- Developer: Mat Benfield (thechelsuk), made in the UK

## Links

- [Opiuml website](https://opiuml.thechels.uk/): the official marketing site
- [Privacy policy](https://thechels.uk/app/privacy): what the app does and does not collect
- [Project page](https://thechels.uk/projects/opiuml): background from the developer

## Features

- Inbox and Queue: swipe to play next, play last or archive
- Per-podcast rules for new episodes, speed and skip intervals
- Chapters, artwork and show notes
- Video podcasts, YouTube channels via RSS and your own audio files
- Apple Watch and CarPlay
- Groups, OPML import and export
- Listening history and stats
- Siri Shortcuts and deep links

## FAQ

### Is Opiuml a good alternative to Overcast, Pocket Casts or Apple Podcasts?

If you follow lots of shows and want to decide what gets played instead of drowning in a feed, yes. The Inbox and Queue workflow makes podcast triage fast, and per-podcast rules automate the rest.

### Can I move my podcasts from another app?

Yes. Export an OPML file from your current podcast player and import it into Opiuml.

### Does Opiuml play YouTube channels?

Yes. Add a YouTube channel by its RSS feed and its videos appear alongside your podcasts.

### How much does it cost?

£29.99 a year, with a one-week free trial for new subscribers.

### When is it available?

Opiuml is coming soon to the App Store for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and CarPlay.
